prompt:
Bounded LTZZZ public task under original task DEEP-SUPERAGENT-20261103. You have no network and no file system; the items below were collected by the operator as a sanitized sample. Mail bodies were never included. Do not claim you read a repo or a mailbox.

Plan EXACTLY ONE worker subtask covering all four items below, so a single seat decides the whole set. Avoid self-review.

Item fields: ref, age_days, status, short_title.
68c0e8cf, 2, open, provider model config: five adjudications, cross-seat review, two leftovers to answer line by line
f37f74a2, 1, open, correction notice says a newer card already covers the older scope, asks to answer two questions on that basis
76204610, 1, open, asks for adjudication on enabling mini-program payment with a rewritten product and a deployment plan
4c401132, 7, unknown, escalation continuation on provider API billing and testnet capability

Assign every item exactly one route from this fixed set: coordinator_close_with_receipt, needs_gpt_decision, needs_owner_decision, blocked_evidence_needed, deploy_confirm_only. Exactly one rule_id per item, and rule_id must be the number of the rule that actually decided it.

Rules in order:
1. if the item only asks to confirm or acknowledge something already merged or already deployed => deploy_confirm_only, with no new deploy and no new merge.
2. if the item requires a merge, a production deploy, a contract change or spending => needs_gpt_decision; the coordinator must not perform it.
3. if the item needs evidence that cannot be produced from this codebase or from what is already recorded => blocked_evidence_needed.
4. if the item is older than five days and explicitly demands every line be answered, or is otherwise ageing without a decision => needs_gpt_decision, so it can never be silently dropped.
5. if the item is a payment, billing, wallet, funds or account-registration matter => needs_owner_decision regardless of age.
6. rule 6 is a negative authority clause, not a routing rule. Never cite rule 6 as the reason for a route. If none of rules 1 to 5 decides an item, return unknown_requires_operator for that item instead of inventing a route.

Return JSON with items (ref, route, rule_id) only, plus a one-line count of how many went to the coordinator versus to a decision seat. No narrative. Structural sample only; preserve IDs; do not retry after an unknown result.
